messages:
Maya (Partnerships): Quick heads-up — StratusCloud + EdgeWorks microwebinar next Wed 10am PT. Need a short ops sync on speaker handoffs, demo ISO certification mention, and who is hand-carrying hardware kits (if any).
Luke (Events): Got it. I can run the 9am show-call. Who are the final speakers?
Maya (Partnerships): Speakers: Priya (StratusCloud), Tomas (EdgeWorks), and our SE lead Sara. Priya will demo marketplace flow, Tomas will do a tiny hw bench (30s), Sara will cover integration notes.
Anika (Marketing): Slide deadline for partner co-brand deck is EOD Mon. Also need final swag list by Tue for the pickup manifest. @ops-bot can you confirm freight vs handcarry rules? :package:
ops-bot: Freight policy: any single kit >15kg must be freighted. Hand-carry allowed for up to 3 kits under 10kg each. Customs docs required for hardware going to EU/UK. Manifest link: https://redwood.internal/ops/ship-manifest
Devon (Eng): For Tomas' hw bench — recommending we include a 2-min reduced run using a cached prefix to avoid long token costs. I'll share a stripped prompt and a tiny dataset.
Maya (Partnerships): Thanks. Action items: 1) Anika upload co-brand deck by Mon EOD, 2) Luke run show-call & stage cue, 3) Devon provide demo prompt + `--realtime` snippet, 4) ops decide hand-carry names or freight.
Luke (Events): I can take stage cues and mic checks. Need the demo timeline (total <=12m). Can someone paste a run-of-show?
Devon (Eng): Run-of-show draft:
```
9:50am - pre-show QA (hosts + partners)
9:58am - record start / intro (1m)
10:00am - Priya marketplace demo (4m)
10:04am - Tomas hw bench (2m)
10:06am - Sara integration + Q&A (4m)
10:10am - close / CTA (2m)
```
Maya (Partnerships): Perfect. Ops note: if Tomas needs an EdgeWorks dev kit on-site, we have two potential couriers: Lina (hand-carry) or freight (3-4 day). Lina is available but needs airport pickup details. @Anika can you confirm if we should use Lina or freight?
Anika (Marketing): Leaning hand-carry if courier can do pickup same-day. Lina available Tue night into Wed morning. I'll confirm by EOD. Also ordering 100 stickers + 50 one-pagers.
Maya (Partnerships): Cool. If Lina is carrying, please add her name + passport number to the manifest (secure channel only). If freighted, ops-bot, please generate the commercial invoice template and ETA.
ops-bot: Commercial invoice template generated: https://redwood.internal/ops/cominvoice/3632109999. ETA estimate (freight): 72-96 hours.
Luke (Events): I'll update the webinar registration CTA to include partner marketplace link and a hardware interest checkbox so sales follows up.
Devon (Eng): One more: for the hw bench, please make sure network is isolated — we run the demo on the private VLAN. I'll add a quick checklist later.
Maya (Partnerships): Great. Last checks: @Anika slides + swag decision by Mon EOD, @Devon demo prompt + checklist by Tue noon, @Luke final run-of-show confirmations by Tue 3pm, ops to confirm hand-carry vs freight by Tue 5pm. Anyone else? :raised_hands:
Anika (Marketing): On it.
Devon (Eng): Will do.
ops-bot: Shipping rule reminder sent to @Maya and @Anika.
Maya (Partnerships): Thanks team — will repost a concise checklist in #partners-ops once we have confirmations. :white_check_mark:
